c74object.name: baco.rms
c74object.description: RMS detector similar to average~, used as the first component of a compressor.

inlet.description: Audio signal used for RMS calculation. Also accepts messages.

method.name: window
method.description: Sets the window length, in samples, used to calculate the RMS of the input signal

arg.name: window
arg.digest: Window length in samples, from 0 to 511

attribute.name: window
attribute.description: Sets the window length, in samples, used to calculate the RMS of the input signal
